relations.subject: Masao Abe (阿部 正雄, Abe Masao)
relations.evidence: Masao Abe (阿部 正雄, Abe Masao; 1915 – September 10, 2006) was a Japanese Buddhist philosopher and religious studies scholar who was emeritus professor at Nara University.
